name: Nero Voice
summary: Local dictation with app styles, spoken snippets and opt-in history; organized meeting recordings and cited notes.
capabilities: Records selected microphone only after dictation, meeting, Talk or reference-recording controls; no launch/hover recording
Apple speech default; optional MLX ASR. Local Qwen presets, cloned references and voice descriptions; shared full/half duplex Talk, no cloud audio.
With macOS Accessibility, pastes shortcut dictation into the originally active app; never presses Send
Per-app Clean/Formal/Literal styles and explicit spoken snippets; optional on-device grammar editing preserves saved snippet text
Shows live focus-free words and recording levels in the Nook or optional bottom captions for Apple Speech and Nemotron; Parakeet transcribes after release
Opt-in local text history with expiry and erase; clipboard is temporarily used and restored for insertion
Offers notes for detected Teams calls; records only after Start notes, with microphone plus chosen app audio. Browser capture includes other tabs.
Saved recording, transcripts and notes can share a local link to an explicitly selected calendar occurrence via separately permitted SDK reads
Local folders and recording imports preserve original files; transcripts and notes retain their optional exact calendar link
One recognition model at a time; Qwen has a separate bounded speech model. Nemotron labels up to eight Room and eight Call speakers.
Bundled local runtimes; no separate Python or cloud audio service. What did I miss uses Apple's model to select settled recent words.
Saves meeting chats locally. Send shares previewed excerpts, labels and recent chat for cited answers across saved meetings; excludes audio and private notes.
